# Code of conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
In short: be respectful and considerate, welcome people of every background
and level of experience, and assume good faith. Harassment, personal attacks
and discriminatory language are not accepted in issues, pull requests,
discussions or any other project space.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour in a project space is a problem, report it privately
through the repository's
**[private report form](https://github.com/sameeralam3127/llm-dev-kit/security/advisories/new)**
(the **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**). Start the title with
"Conduct:" so it is not mistaken for a security report. Only the maintainer
can read it.

Reports are handled by the maintainer, in confidence, as soon as they can.
The response follows the Contributor Covenant's enforcement guidelines:
from a private word, through a warning, to a temporary or permanent ban,
depending on what happened.
